notes.title: The delay and optimization
notes.content:
[h1]📣 Announcement: Update on optimization and light baking[/h1]

Hey @everyone,

We are sorry for the unannounced delay and the problems it created. We know all of you were super excited for the next chapters as we are but now we were getting so many users who were complaining about lumen not performing how it should be resulting in a unplayable game.

So we decided to bake the lighting and keep lumen as a option to enable for now. This will let players experience the world of Liminalcore in better way and also let other play who couldn’t play it before because of hardware limitations of Lumen.

This baked lighting approach will also help us plan for a VR Update in future! No promises on VR yet.

A sneak peek into the upcoming chapters :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136111/4d28dcb207a9699fd39ee1d9b5b3ca82a893b723.png[/img]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

We sincerely apologize for this slight delay, but we want to deliver the best possible experience for you all. These chapters are shaping up to be truly amazing, and we’re confident the wait will be worth it.

[h3]Lumen / issues [/h3]

There were alot of people who’s pc met the minimum requirements and still lumen wasn’t working how it suppose to be on there machines. In result people were getting disappointed and also some negative reviews. We were trying to solve the issue but lumen is a recent tech and it needs some time to be stable.
We decided to bake the lights so more people can play and experience the game. We had some dynamic environments planned for next chapters but now we had to make some changes according to our needs and limitations.

[b]We aren’t gonna reveal release date rightnow but as soon as we are done and satisfied with the results we will be revealing a release date with a new trailer of next chapters. [/b]

Thank you for your patience, support, and excitement. We can’t wait for you to dive into these new experiences.

— With gratitude, From Team Liminalcore

notes.title: Update on new chapters and slight delay
notes.content:
[h1]📣 Announcement: Update on Liminalcore’s New Chapters [/h1]

Hey @everyone,

We’ve got a quick update regarding the release of the two new chapters of Liminalcore. While we originally planned to launch on 24 January, we’ve decided to take a little extra time to polish everything and ensure a smoother, more immersive experience.

[h2]The new release date for the chapters is 30 January 2025.[/h2]

We sincerely apologize for this slight delay, but we want to deliver the best possible experience for you all. These chapters are shaping up to be truly amazing, and we’re confident the wait will be worth it.

[h3]Who knows, we might just cook up another chapter later this year! 👀[/h3]


Thank you for your patience, support, and excitement. We can’t wait for you to dive into these new experiences.

— With gratitude, From Team 🦉

notes.title: New Chapters Release Date
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Happy New Year! 🎉[/h1]

As we step into 2025, we want to take a moment to reflect on the incredible journey we’ve had with Liminalcore. This past year has been nothing short of extraordinary, and it’s all thanks to YOU—our amazing community.

[h2]A Year to Remember[/h2]

Liminalcore has grown far beyond our expectations, becoming a cherished Backrooms experience and a shining inspiration for local indie developers. Your unwavering support has turned it into not just a game, but a symbol of what’s possible for indie game development.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

We’re excited to announce that two brand-new chapters of Liminalcore are on their way, offering even more immersive, unsettling, and mysterious Backrooms experiences.

🗓 [b]Release Date:
The next chapters will be available on 24 January 2025.[/b]

We’re taking extra care to ensure these updates elevate the experience to new levels of fear and fascination.

Thank You

Thank you for making 2024 a milestone year for us. Your love, feedback, and support have driven us to push boundaries and dream bigger. We can’t wait to share what’s next and continue this journey with all of you.

Here’s to another year of mystery, discovery, and unforgettable moments!

— With gratitude, From Team 🦉

notes.title: Exciting News: Two New Chapters Are Coming to Liminalcore!
notes.content:
[h2]We’re thrilled to share that we’re hard at work on two additional chapters for Liminalcore![/h2] These new chapters will not only expand the game but also enhance the overall experience, adding more depth and intrigue to the world you’ve been exploring.

[h2]Here’s what you can expect:[/h2]

[b]Chapter 5:[/b] Scheduled for release in December 2024

[b]Chapter 6:[/b] Following closely in January 2025

Together, these chapters will add an additional 30–45 minutes of gameplay, filled with new challenges, eerie environments, and unsettling discoveries. This expansion will complete our initial vision of Liminalcore.

We’re incredibly grateful for the support and enthusiasm from our amazing community—it’s because of you that we’re able to continue building on this project. We can’t wait to share these new chapters with you and hear your thoughts!

Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the release dates.

Thank you for being a part of the Liminalcore journey!

notes.title: ✨ Liminalcore is Officially Released! ✨
notes.content:
[h2] What's next in the world of Liminalcore [/h2]
We’re beyond excited to finally bring Liminalcore to you all! Originally, we had planned even more content for this initial release. However, as a small team facing some unexpected challenges, we decided to focus on delivering a polished experience now and release additional content as free chapter updates over time.

[h2] Lore [/h2]
The game has a deep lore we’re eager for you to uncover. Each new chapter will immerse you further into the unsettling world of Liminalcore, and we'll also be expanding the current four chapters with fresh content to deepen the experience. We have so many unique, liminal experiences to share, and we’ll be posting a full roadmap in the next day to outline what’s coming!

Thank you for your patience and support, and please read on for more details:

Liminalcore is Released!

We apologize for the delay; it impacted the release timing, and we’re incredibly grateful for your patience and support. This game has been a true labor of love, and we're excited to finally share it with you.

As our first release, we deeply value your feedback. If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam—it helps us immensely! If you encounter any bugs or performance issues (as we know UE5’s Lumen Ray Tracing can be demanding), please share your thoughts with us in our Feedback channel on [url=https://discord.gg/PxRp5JEjXt]Discord[/url]. We’re actively working on patches to optimize performance and address any issues.

Thank you for being part of this experience with us. Dive in, explore the unknown, and welcome to Liminalcore!

Warm regards,

notes.title: Release Update – Small Delay on Launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First off, we want to thank you for the incredible support and excitement around our game, Liminalcore. Our team has been working tirelessly to bring you a polished and immersive experience.

[b]However, we’re facing some unexpected electricity and internet issues ( in our area ) that are impacting our ability to upload the final build. This new build contains important fixes and improvements that are crucial for the best gameplay experience, so we want to make sure it's perfect before release.[/b]

[b]We anticipate the release will be delayed by a few hours, possibly extending up to a day at most. We’re doing everything we can to resolve these issues quickly and get the game live as soon as possible.[/b]

We sincerely apologize for the delay and deeply appreciate your patience and understanding. Liminalcore is our first release, and we are incredibly proud of the experience we’ve created for you. In the meantime, if you have questions or want to chat with us directly, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/PxRp5JEjXt]Discord server.[/url]

Thank you again for your support – stay tuned for more updates, and we can’t wait to welcome you into the unsettling world of Liminalcore soon!

notes.title: Liminal Core - Playtest & Feedback Patches
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136111/84a0105a6b26b85c47ca9bd4387cd4c3315ea970.png[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone!
[/h1]
We’re excited to share the progress we’ve made based on the feedback from the playtest sessions on September 26! We had a blast watching you explore the eerie, unsettling spaces of Liminalcore, and your feedback has been invaluable in helping us polish the game. Here’s a breakdown of the updates and fixes that we implemented in the next patch, just a day after the first playtest session:

[h2]Patch Notes:
[/h2][list]
[*] Caustics Added: Enhancing the water visuals to create a more immersive experience.
[*] FOV Slider: Now you can customize your field of view for better control.
[*] Headbobbing Slider: Adjust the intensity to match your comfort level.
[*] VHS Effect Settings: Fine-tune the VHS aesthetic with new options for Fisheye Intensity and VHS Grain Intensity.
[*] Bug Fixes:
[*] Water not loading in certain areas has been fixed.
[*] Resolved strange wave effects near the Dark Zone with a house.
[*] Added controller support for interactions and zooming (Right Trigger for zoom, Left Trigger for interaction).
[*] Fixed the frustrating bug where players would get stuck while sliding.
[*] Corrected footsteps playing tile sounds even when walking in water.
[*] Fixed invisible stairs issue.
[*] Lights no longer disappear at a distance.
[*] Fixed water textures breaking while mounting/dismounting ladders.
[*] Smoothed out the janky ladder end animation.
[*] Splash sounds are now fixed when jumping on tiles.
[*] Resolved a bug where the player would start running unintentionally in “THAT” section.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:
[/h2][list]
[*] Running speed in water has been increased.
[*] Headbobbing has been refined for a smoother experience (no more wobbly camera!).
[/list]

We’re so grateful for your feedback and can’t wait to hear more as we continue improving the game. Your input is key to making Liminalcore the best it can be!

[b]The demo will be live soon, and we’re thrilled to finally share this project with you all. It’s been a challenging but incredibly rewarding journey for our small team, and we couldn’t have done it without your support.[/b]

Thank you for sticking with us through this process. Let’s make Liminalcore the unforgettable liminal experience it’s meant to be!

notes.title: Liminal Core - Devlog 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, This is our first devlog. We will be sharing our progress every week! Stay tuned for more.
Development is going great and we have finished a couple of mechanics that will be seen through out the whole game.

We have finished Level 37 - The Poolrooms and actively working on the remaining levels! Liminalcore will be multiple backroom levels experience.

[h1]New Mechanics[/h1]

[h3]VHS Camera Filter[/h3]
We've added an option in the menu that allows players to toggle the VHS camera filter on or off, giving them the freedom to customize their experience according to their preferences.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYnAzbzk5MWdscmdyc3RwZDh2MGNtMXhheXV4cTQ0cHVyNTRlbnN1bCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/nyZbr5TmF3gnMO6ykV/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Water Interaction System[/h3]
As the game begins at Level 37 - Poolrooms, our primary focus was to create an immersive and realistic water experience.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNHk5anZ4cXk0M3RzMWdnaWZyOHM0cG15ZTdoenhjdzltaWM0eWJhNCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/a8RX7RViheatyHf1Js/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h3]Slide Mechanic[/h3]
And of course, a poolroom experience wouldn’t be complete without slides.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNW01MG5pN3Q3bTBqMXphYjVhcHVmb291cGlwdHUxMGU5NXN1bHRlciZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/STKLoyLqvdbWbBgA5s/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted Stair Collision to act as a ramp to remove camera jitter while walking up
[*]Adjusted Collision of walls and floors to avoid falling through the map at some places.
[*]Adjusted Lumen settings to remove weird flickering.
[*]Fixed Ambience Volumes to better fade between two different ambiences.
[*]Added Footstep Sound based on surface.
[/list]
